notes.title: Development Update August 2018
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all, sorry for disappearing the past months. To be honest we've had to momentarily pause Initiative's development due to lack of funds and had to focus our time on other projects and side-jobs to be able to continue with it in the future. As we said before, this is our passion and we will finish this game no matter what, it just may take a little longer!

But not all are bad news. Last year we've applied for a government incentive to software development and we've just received confirmation that Initiative has been selected as one of the winner projects. This means that once we receive that money we will be able to gather a small team, rent an office and work full time on the game, pretty much like we would have accomplished had the Kickstarter been successful.

It may take a couple of months to receive the funds but once there we estimate to have a demo three months later and a first early access version on Steam six months later.

We'll try to post here more often as before. Also wanted to thank all of you for your continuous support and good wishes!.

Nick and Seb
